seo.title: PPC & Performance Marketing Services
seo.description: Paid search, paid social and native performance marketing campaigns engineered for measurable customer acquisition across insurance, home services and web lead verticals.

hero.headline: PPC / Performance Marketing
hero.subheadline: Paid media engineered around acquisition outcomes, not impressions.

overview: Performance marketing is the engine behind every product we deliver. We plan and run paid search, paid social, native and comparison campaigns with a single objective: reach consumers at the moment of active intent and convert that intent into a lead, a call or a transfer for our clients.

Because we operate across dozens of sub-verticals, our media teams bring category benchmarks, keyword intelligence and creative learnings to every new program, and every campaign is measured to the outcome it produced.

seo.title: Web Lead Generation Services
seo.description: Form leads, real-time leads, qualified leads and high-intent web leads delivered directly to your CRM with validation, consent capture and duplicate suppression.

hero.headline: Web Lead Generation
hero.subheadline: Customer information captured online and delivered to your team as a validated, real-time lead.

overview: Web leads are consumers who complete a form expressing interest in a product or service. We generate them through performance campaigns and conversion-focused landing pages, then validate, de-duplicate and post each record to your CRM, dialer or lead management platform in real time.
Lead programs are configured to your acceptance criteria, including geography, product interest, and field-level requirements, and are available across every sub-vertical we support.

seo.title: Inbound Call Generation | Pay Per Call
seo.description: High-intent, qualified, industry-specific inbound calls delivered in real time to your sales team. Pay per call programs across insurance, home services and web lead verticals.

hero.headline: Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Consumers who actively pick up the phone and call about your product, routed to your team in real time.

overview: An inbound call is the strongest intent signal in marketing. The consumer has seen an offer, decided they want to talk, and dialled. We generate these calls through click-to-call and call-only campaigns and route them to your agents the moment they connect.
Every sub-vertical we support has a dedicated inbound call product page, because the consumer, the qualification and the buyer requirements differ in each market.

features.title: Qualified calls

features.title: Industry-specific calls
features.text: Dedicated programs for every sub-vertical, from auto insurance to pest control to personal loans.

features.title: Real-time delivery
features.text: Calls ring your sales line the instant the consumer dials.

features.title: Geo and schedule routing

features.title: Call tracking and recording
features.text: Full visibility into source, duration and outcome for every call.

seo.title: Live Transfer Lead Generation
seo.description: Consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred directly to your agents. Live transfer programs across insurance, home services and web lead verticals.

hero.headline: Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: A consumer, qualified and on the line, warm-transferred to your team while intent is at its peak.

overview: Live transfers put a qualification layer in front of your agents. Our team engages the consumer, confirms they meet your criteria, and warm-transfers the call directly to your designated destination, so your agents speak only with consumers who match.
Live transfer programs are available for every sub-vertical we support, each with criteria and scripts tailored to that market.

features.title: Real-time transfer
